headline: CISCE Releases 2027 Examination Timetables For Class 10 And 12
metaDescription: The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations has published the 2027 board exam dates for Class 10 and 12 students across India.
aiSummaryBullets: The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) released official timetables for the 2027 board sessions.
ISC Class 12 examinations are scheduled to take place between February 9 and April 8, 2027.
ICSE Class 10 examinations are set to commence on February 15 and conclude on March 31, 2027.
aiContextParagraph: The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE) is the governing body responsible for organizing annual board examinations for Class 10 (ICSE) and Class 12 (ISC) students. The newly published 2027 schedules include a range of core subjects such as Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, English, and various elective papers. According to the board, standard protocols remain in place for the upcoming cycle, including a mandated 15-minute period for students to review question papers prior to beginning their written responses. Morning exam sessions are set to transition from reading time at 10:00 AM to the commencement of writing at 10:15 AM. These examinations are conducted nationwide, requiring students to prepare for an academic cycle that spans from early February through early April. The official release allows schools and students to coordinate their final preparation strategies for the upcoming board assessments.
whyItIsViral: The release of board examination dates triggered high search interest across India as students and educational institutions began planning for the 2027 academic cycle.
